purpose: Explicit review ledger for maintained direct assignments to level.hints or level.hintRecords. New assignments fail the hostile audit until classified.

entries.rationale: setLevelHintRecords() is the sole canonical synchronization boundary; it assigns hintRecords first and derives bare hints from those semantic records.
Assignments construct wire/clone views for serialization and engine cloning. They do not mutate persisted Hint authority; canonical persisted mutation remains setLevelHintRecords().
